title: Pregnancy VTE: interim changes to risk assessment and LMWH dosing (GTG37a)
reason: RCOG interim guidance that changes risk assessment and weight-based prescribing at booking and postnatally; UK body, directly practice-changing, and it supersedes the edition the in-app guide reflects

title: Parenteral nutrition: use an in-line filter to prevent embolic harm
reason: MHRA safety alert with one concrete action on wards O&G covers, including neonatal; a reported death makes the stakes unambiguous

title: Birth trends: caesarean rate reaches 42.8% across Great Britain
reason: National maternity audit data a UK trainee is expected to be able to quote; earns its place as awareness even though it directs nothing

title: Domperidone: avoid use in suspected phaeochromocytoma
reason: Genuine MHRA prescribing change, but the trigger is a rare endocrine diagnosis rather than anything in O&G practice; an obstetric antiemetic choice almost never turns on it, so it is noise in this feed

title: NGPod pH devices: quarantine and dispose of withdrawn stock
reason: Correct UK device withdrawal, wrong audience: quarantining stock is a nursing and procurement action, not a trainee decision. Device alerts only belong here when a trainee changes what they do

title: Gynaecology waiting list rises again as new referrals increase
reason: Already covered in the news section, so it duplicates something the reader has seen. A duplication reject, not a category one: RCOG gynaecology reports are welcome when the story is not already carried elsewhere
